analysis.title: Adding defensive exposure to European AI stocks // Selling puts in China AI Tech
key_insights: UBS Sales and Trading (not UBS Research) published two derivatives ideas on 29-Oct-2026: adding defensive exposure to the European AI ecosystem, and put selling in China AI tech names YOFC and KBL.
The put-selling idea on YOFC and KBL is framed around UBS Research viewing China AI tech as oversold.

The EU MAR disclosure lists new Longer Delta Derivative recommendations at 09:03 on 29-Oct-2026 in ASML (up to 6 months), Air Liquide, Anglo American, Schneider Electric and Siemens Energy (each up to 3 months).
The extracted text contains only headings and the disclosure tables. The trade structures, strikes, expiries and charts are not in the text, so no further detail can be reported.
